name: QTN rebases on every transfer out of the pair, including skims, while the pair's balance is not rebased
summary: QUATERNION's _transfer treats any transfer from the QTN/WETH pair as a buy and calls rebasePlus(amount), raising _totalSupply by a fifth of the amount and so every gon-based balance, while the pair's own balance is kept in a separate counter (uniswapV2PairAmount) that rebases do not touch. Skim counts as such a transfer. After buying QTN for 2.19 WETH, the attacker's contract 0xa33c965c repeatedly sent its QTN to the pair and skimmed it out to 25 helper contracts per transaction, each skim inflating the attacker's holdings against the fixed pair balance; it collected the helpers' QTN back in alternate transactions and after 22 rounds sold into the pair for 4.74 WETH, then repeated a short run from a second contract.
notes: Reset is the token's deployment (block 12899166). The owner lifted the per-transaction limit (_percentForTxLimit 2 to 100, 0x8edf6524, block 12899603) and renounced ownership the next block; the limit only bounds the amounts and updateLive is callable by anyone, so neither is a reset (rule 8).

Earlier exploits: every transaction since deployment in which QTN left the pair more often than the pair emitted Swap was listed (788 transactions with QTN out of the pair to block 16440000). Besides this attacker's runs, only 0xe69bfbef (block 16392919, 2023-01-12, by 0x62407f86) qualifies, and it exploits a different bug: skim(pair) sends QTN from the pair to itself, which _tokenTransfer adds to uniswapV2PairAmount without subtracting, doubling the pair's recorded balance 16 times before a swap took 6.52 WETH. It is a separate incident (rule 4) and is not in this record. campaign.mjs lists every earlier QTN transfer from the pair (783, ordinary buys) and adds nothing to this check.

Loss is the pair's WETH outflow to the attacker in its two sales (4.7363 WETH in 0xd78380d1 and 0.3214 WETH in 0x9bb5e24c, 8,023.11 USD) less the WETH it put into the pair to buy its starting QTN (2.1911 WETH in 0x352320bf, 0.0819 WETH in 0x6f52d876), 3,573.09 USD (rule 11), priced per transaction at DefiLlama; the pair's QTN is not valued (rule 12).
